title: 100% Tariff on Pharmaceutical Imports to the US and its Impact on Singapore Economy
what_it_is: 100% Tariff on Pharmaceutical Imports to the US and its Impact on Singapore Economy

sections.label: Singapore pharmaceutical exports to US
sections.summary: Between 2022 and 2024, Singapore's pharmaceutical exports to the US averaged S$3.7 billion per year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Between 2022 and 2024, Singapore’s pharmaceutical exports to the US averaged S$3.7 billion per year.

sections.label: US tariff exemption discussions
sections.summary: Companies await US details on tariff exemption eligibility, while Singapore discusses a preferential tariff arrangement for its pharmaceutical exports to the US.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Many already have plans to build new capacity or expand their existing facilities in the US and are awaiting further details from the US administration to confirm that their plans would qualify for the tariff exemption.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We are also in discussion with the US administration on a preferential tariff arrangement for Singapore’s pharmaceutical exports to the US and will provide an update when ready.

sections.label: Pharmaceutical share of exports
sections.summary: As of 2024, pharmaceutical products were 13% of Singapore's domestic exports to the US and 19% of its pharmaceutical exports to the US.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As of 2024, 13% of our domestic exports to the US were pharmaceutical products.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: And this makes up 19% of our pharmaceutical exports to the US.

sections.label: Preferential tariff talks ongoing
sections.summary: The Singapore Government is still in discussion with the US on a preferential tariffs arrangement for Singapore's pharmaceutical exports to the US.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Singapore Government is still currently in discussion with the US on preferential tariffs arrangement for our pharmaceutical exports to the US.

sections.label: Gan and Lutnick virtual meeting
sections.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Gan had a virtual meeting with US Secretary Lutnick last week on a broad framework, with details being followed up.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In particular, Deputy Prime Minister Gan just had a virtual meeting with US Secretary Lutnick last week on a broad framework and the details are being followed up.

sections.label: Research funding for pharmaceutical sector
sections.summary: Under the Research, Innovation and Enterprise 2025 Plan, $28 billion is committed for research and innovation, including biotech and life science research, with RIE 2030 funding to be announced later this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Indeed, it is in our interest to try to continue to be an attractive place for investments and R&D in the pharmaceutical sector under the Research, Innovation and Enterprise 2025 Plan.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We have committed $28 billion for research and innovation with the intent to accelerate human health and potential as one of the key focus areas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: This includes funding to drive research and translational efforts in the biotech and life science sectors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We will be announcing the research funding under RIE 2030 later this year.
